# Vendored browser runtime

- Egret Engine community rebuild, branch main, pinned commit [ef900ac852d68070c8f37cf131560234c5f27db4](https://github.com/cnedwin/Egret_rebuild/tree/ef900ac852d68070c8f37cf131560234c5f27db4).
- The contracts, runtime and engine packages were built from a clean checkout of 83705c01b0d01ef599abf06d5150f67d56683b76, whose complete Git tree matches the pinned commit (e5afd1d698a4d543d11a303f4d7a216d60bf7e14).
- Built with Node.js 26.7.0 and TypeScript 7.0.2 using upstream `node tools/build.mjs`.
- robust-predicates 3.0.3 is the engine dependency. The original license is retained next to the package.
